description: Header file defining classes related to audio playback tracks in Android's AudioFlinger, including OpPlayAudioMonitor, Track, OutputTrack, and PatchTrack, with methods for managing audio playback, volume, haptic feedback, and synchronization.

classes.name: OpPlayAudioMonitor
classes.description: Monitors OP_PLAY_AUDIO permission status for audio tracks.

classes.name: Track
classes.description: Represents an audio playback track with methods for control, metadata, volume, and haptic feedback.

classes.name: OutputTrack
classes.description: A subclass of Track used for duplicating audio streams, with buffer queue management.

classes.name: PatchTrack
classes.description: A subclass of Track used for patching audio streams with specific start and buffer management.

methods.name: hasOpPlayAudio
methods.description: Checks if OP_PLAY_AUDIO permission is active.

methods.name: createIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates an OpPlayAudioMonitor instance if needed.

methods.name: Track
methods.description: Constructor for initializing an audio track with various parameters.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks if track initialization was successful.

methods.name: sampleRate
methods.description: Returns the sample rate of the track.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves timestamp info for the track.

methods.name: setFinalVolume
methods.description: Sets the final volume for the track.

methods.name: presentationComplete
methods.description: Checks if presentation of the track is complete.

methods.name: isPlaybackRestricted
methods.description: Checks if playback is restricted due to OP permissions.

methods.name: getNextBuffer
methods.description: Provides the next buffer for playback.

methods.name: presentationComplete
methods.description: Checks if track presentation is complete based on frames or time.

methods.name: updateTrackFrameInfo
methods.description: Updates frame info for the track.
